title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.1 (Peaked September 23, 2026 at 15:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 309 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nothing unusual at the moment. 🌎💫

The Sun shows several compact active regions and broad darker coronal structure, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward eruption.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
